signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story split-level house frontage across a large front lawn; overhead wires cross the top of the frame but do not obscure the house.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Foundation beds with red shrubs, ornamental grasses and a blue spruce look tidy, but there is no crew, equipment or other clear sign of professional maintenance.

signals.notes: Well-kept blue-sided split-level with a lush green lawn, tidy foundation plantings, a white vinyl fence on the right and two cars parked in the driveway on the left.
